title: IDOL 01R MV Direction Reference Mining
description: Retired evidence-only compatibility schema for historical 01R records. It is readable for preserved v4 bytes but must not be authored, profile-loaded, selected, or section-bound in the active route. Active reference research lives inside front-planning-readiness.v17 and reaches section use only through the CDD-reviewed Reference Working Index. Historical AMV/MAD or other restricted rows remain readable evidence and never gain current-task permission from this schema.

visual_reference_application_policy.description: Required by v2. An applied visual use must select bounded_surface_direct, full_scene_direct, or sequence_direct; directorial_function remains research-only legacy vocabulary.

interpretation_contract_version.description: Opt in for new/resumed 01R work. Legacy v1 artifacts without this field remain schema-readable; a resumed ready handoff must migrate selected rows before 01 consumes them.

reference_gap_contract_version.description: Opt in for new/resumed function-gap closure within the Front Planning 01R substage. Legacy 01R artifacts remain readable; a resumed pass enables this contract after projecting the Front Planning coverage seed.

audience_connection_contract_version.description: Opt in for new/resumed 01R work inside Front Planning. Selected sources and section cards must bind a validated audience connection and a whole-MV content role; performance/choreography remains an optional role, never the default. Legacy artifacts remain readable but migrate before material resume.

reference_comparison_contract_version.description: Opt in for new/resumed per-visual-section reference comparison. Each active section reviews at least three independently inspectable units from at least two original source identities across at least two functions before closeout.

video_sequence_contract_version.description: Opt in for new/resumed duration-aware video reference review. Hub sheets remain non-counting navigation surfaces; each reviewed video unit attaches its exact selected range as hash-bound one-second evidence, then records event-driven phase frames and a conditional upstream/Core-Cut/Branch-Cut realization plan without a fixed frame count.

operating_mode.description: Active v3 uses front_planning_reference_connection. The other modes remain readable for legacy runs.

selected_audio_analysis.description: Run-owned selected-audio analysis used for actual section map, lyrics read, pulse, onset, and song energy context in post-song-lock 01R.

audio_motion_director_map.description: Run-owned selected-song rhythm-to-screen evidence required by the active Front Planning reference-connection mode.

lyrics_direction_bridge.description: Legacy compatibility pointer for historical direction-mining artifacts. Active 01R uses selected_audio_analysis and audio_motion_director_map directly.

track_creative_board.description: Optional album/title read-model pointer when it already carries song, space, wardrobe, 01A, 01R, or 02A decisions.

front_planning_readiness.description: Run-owned Front Planning draft/readiness carrier. It is required by active v3 so 01R answers named target, message, section, and screen-function gaps rather than building a generic pool.

reference_registry.description: Optional run-owned reference registry that classifies song, lyric/message, planning, visual, direction, object, performance, identity, and operations references before 01R selects current-song uses.

visual_identity_refs.description: Optional identity or member asset refs that constrain how reference functions may be adapted.

prior_research_refs.description: Optional previously gathered run or related-run research refs intentionally reused by this 01R pass.

reference_image_manifest.description: Optional run-owned image-reference manifest or INDEX path for grouped visual candidates used by this 01R pass. Missing local images should be recorded as needs_asset_reingest in reference_image_intake rather than silently treated as available.

local_reference_cache_manifest.description: Optional run-local ignored cache manifest, usually research/_local_reference_cache/manifest.local.yaml, when 01R downloaded or extracted public video/still evidence.

album_reference_index.description: Optional pointer-only catalog/albums/ALBUM_KEY/TITLE_KEY/reference-index.yaml used to find run-local or durable reference evidence without broad rediscovery.

album_contact_sheet_index.description: Optional pointer-only catalog/albums/ALBUM_KEY/TITLE_KEY/contact-sheet-index.yaml used to find broad or dense contact-sheet parts.

source_materials_video_index_refs.description: Optional durable source-material video index paths reused by this 01R pass across titles or albums.

reference_library_refs.description: Optional reference-library notes used for reusable camera, body, object, wardrobe, scene, or edit functions. These do not replace source identity or current-song translation.

song_choreography_performance_mv_map.description: Required for legacy post-01 reinforcement. Optional for post-song-lock direction mining before 01 exists.

founder_approval_ref.description: Thread note, review note, or local artifact showing founder approval to use external references for this pass.

adapted_to_01.description: True only after chosen application candidates have been recombined into the 01 map.

assigned_to_front_planning.description: True only after the selected reference units and exact interpretation ids are assigned to named Front Planning sections.

use_rule.description: State that 01R informs 01 only; it must not replace song message, member identity, selected audio timing, wardrobe lanes, or founder locks.

what_this_file_decides.description: Optional explicit decision scope preserved for handoff readability.

what_this_file_does_not_decide.description: Optional explicit non-decision scope preserved so downstream agents do not overread 01R.

selection_mode.description: Founder selection remains available, but the preferred 01R flow is Codex researches, preselects, applies selected director_chain_effect values to 01, then founder reviews the result at 02A preview/storyboard review.

founder_delegation_ref.description: Thread note, review note, or local artifact that records the founder's instruction for Codex-first selection/application. Use an empty string only when Codex is recommending but not applying.

selection_strictness.description: How assertively Codex may carry source observations into 01 director_chain_effect values. IDOL 01R defaults to aggressive: preserve useful raw details, then review them at 02A.

codex_may_apply_to_01.description: True when selection_mode allows Codex to update 01 from selected 01R candidates before founder review.

post_apply_founder_review_required.description: True when Codex may apply first but the founder must review the result at the declared downstream review stage.

post_apply_review_stage.description: Where the founder reviews Codex's applied 01R decisions. Default IDOL 01R flow reviews them at 02A preview/storyboard review.

review_surface.description: Compatibility field name for the founder review material or review stage. For Codex-first mode, this should name 02A preview/storyboard review.

allowed_reference_types.description: For section/function-first MV research, official/original professional primary sources are the active default. The amv_or_mad_edit and short_form_response_edit tokens remain historical compatibility vocabulary only and never authorize query, opening, inspection, registration, response-pattern use, candidacy, or binding; an exact current-task Founder permission must be recorded on the capture before any allowed action.

banned_reference_types.description: Compatibility field for safety, identity, or tone stop-states that are too specific for allowed_reference_types, such as literal weapon scenes or source-world genre traps. This field must not ban direct following of selected references.

source_diversity_policy.description: Required for post-song-lock direction mining. Records the source-lane mix and raw-intake scope before section/beat direction cards are selected.

minimum_distinct_reference_types.description: Minimum distinct allowed_reference_types that should be represented unless founder-local-only or web-unavailable status is recorded.

minimum_search_lanes.description: Minimum source-search lanes to sample before applying 01R choices.

raw_intake_scope.description: State how literally source section jobs, scenes, outfits, choreography, camera, identity, staging, and edit grammar should be observed before later selection.

redundancy_check.description: How Codex tracks repeated source details or repeated source functions across selected 01R cards.

max_single_source_dependency.description: Plain-language policy for using one source family, including cases where a founder-selected source is followed directly as the visual standard.

required_mix.description: Optional AI/model-readable mix of source lanes that must be represented.

reference_function_coverage.description: 01R's semantic closure of the stable Front Planning function/section rows. A derived worklist may compare these rows and hashes, but Sol owns candidate interpretation, selection, and closure.

reference_image_intake.description: Optional class/lane map for 01R image-reference work. Use it when the pass searches, inventories, or applies still-image, key-visual, concept-photo, founder-local, object/space, or contact-sheet references. It is a management and gap-check layer; downstream 01/02A consume adapted text locks and trace refs, not raw images by default.

management_rule.description: State where image candidates are indexed, how source names remain traceable, and how each selected image is translated into a current-song function before 01/01A/02A use.

lane_id.description: Stable lane id from the registry or this 01R pass, such as VR-01 or intro_lens_threshold.

visual_function.description: The transferable current-song function, such as intro camera threshold, practice evidence, object wall, voice-room intimacy, or transition memory.

gap_actions.description: Concrete next actions for missing or weak lanes. Public search entries must name the missing question; asset issues must name the needed file or reingest route.

local_reference_cache.description: Optional management surface for run-local 01R video/still captures and contact-sheet evidence. Use when public references are downloaded, frame-extracted, or dense-sheeted during 01R.

storage_rule.description: State that run-specific downloads and extracted media stay in the ignored run-local cache, while catalog stores pointer rows only.

dense_sheet_policy.description: State whether 2-3 second dense sheets are unused, selected-range only, or split by section/source range/fixed parts; one full-MV dense sheet is not acceptable review material.

promotion_note.description: Optional note when evidence remains current-title only, moves to source-materials/video-sources, or is summarized in reference-library.

reference_captures.description: Compatibility field name for 01R source observation records. Values should preserve what was observed, then separate source-use/current-song adaptation from final downstream prompt language. The transferable_variables field remains for legacy compatibility; new post-song-lock work should emphasize source_use and section_direction_cards.

source_type.description: Per-capture source classification. Restricted edit tokens remain readable for historical held/rejected rows but need exact current-task Founder permission before any active action or reuse.

short_description.description: Optional compact current-run reason this reference was captured.

source_identity_preserved.description: True when the source title/path is intentionally preserved for audit while downstream prompts still adapt the function.

capture_mode.description: How the reference was observed before adaptation. Image bundles such as teaser photos, concept photos, album covers, promo stills, thumbnails, and key visuals should use contact_sheet_observation instead of one-record-per-image capture.

contact_sheet_ref.description: Run-owned contact sheet path or source page used as the grouped visual observation material. Required by graph-engineering prose for image bundles, optional in schema for non-image references.

audience_connection_binding.description: Binds this source to the validated target/response-mechanism/screen-translation map and the whole-MV content role it validates or implements.

source_context_verification.description: Proves that the title, original work or artist, and scene/segment context are clear enough to identify and reject a wrong original, AMV, MAD, or short before capture or use.

identity_status.description: The response-edit value is historical compatibility evidence and does not grant active access or reuse without restricted_source_permission.

response_signal_use.description: The AMV/MAD/short value may be used only within the exact actions named by restricted_source_permission; otherwise the row remains held/rejected historical evidence.

contact_sheet_review.description: Optional structured pointer to broad or dense contact-sheet evidence used for this capture. Use it when 01R observed source video through sheet parts or selected cells/frames.

segmentation_rule.description: How the sheet was split for readability: active section, source time range, fixed 30-60 second parts, or selected repair range. A one-sheet full-MV dense scan should be marked as a blocker in prose, not as ready evidence.

discovery_evidence.description: Public-video discovery evidence. Raw popularity is retained only as a tie-break after target/message relevance and diversity; upload age is intentionally absent.

visual_direction_read.description: Prompt-contract-level visual reading of the selected source surface. This records observable action, gaze, camera, composition, depth, and transfer rules; it is not a pixel-audit checklist or final provider prompt.

raw_capture.description: Compatibility field name for the literal source observation before adaptation. Values should describe what is visible or audible in the source, not final prompt language.

raw_bundle_observation.description: Literal bundled source details worth preserving for later review or selection.

non_selected_bundle_drift.description: Legacy compatibility field. Treat as reference-use notes for how founder/current-run selected details may travel downstream, not as a ban on direct reference use.

apply_when_delegated.description: True when Codex should apply this candidate to 01 in Codex-first or delegated application mode.

requires_founder_review.description: True when the candidate changes message meaning, member owner, wardrobe lane, or a major section route.

director_chain_effect.description: Current-song values that may update the existing 01 screen_cause_effect or director_chain while preserving explicit raw-source trace.

body_camera_evidence.description: Compatibility field name; write body/camera readability detail here, not abstract validation labels.

body_camera_details.description: Compatibility alias used by existing run artifacts; write body/camera readability detail here.

wardrobe_motion.description: Compatibility compact wardrobe-motion field. New current-song applications should also fill wardrobe_read.

section_reference_comparisons.description: One comparison pool per active visual section. The minimum applies to reviewed candidates, not to the number of references finally applied or combined.

section_direction_cards.description: Optional post-song-lock 01R section/cut cards. Use selected-audio sections first, then cut-level cards when useful. These cards combine lyric context, audio context, source use, concrete screen translation, 03 video-prompt readiness, and 04 edit-readiness without becoming final edit truth.

status.description: Section-gate status for this 01R card when it is used as a slice handoff.

reference_comparison_id.description: Matching section_reference_comparisons row for the active visual section.

lyric_cue.description: Actual lyric surface or no-lyric cue. Lyrics may be quoted here as cue context; do not use this field as visible action by itself.

lyric_context.description: What the lyric or no-lyric cue is doing in the song: message job, emotional turn, target-empathy receive, or section function.

reference_id.description: Reference capture id or local source note id.

source_note.description: Direct observation or source-use note. It may describe the source, but the downstream screen_translation must adapt it to the current song.

visible_action.description: Concrete observable action. Do not leave this as lyric interpretation or abstract emotion.

source_image_assumption.description: Expected 03 source mode: one Branch-Cut image, ordered Branch-Cut image set, pass-through image set, or review board image.

must_carry.description: Optional compact list of non-negotiable visible details for later video prompts.

do_not_show.description: Optional compact list of forbidden visible outcomes for later video prompts.

raw_capture_boundary.description: Literal source observations may describe the source as seen or heard, but must stay in 01R.

adaptation_rule.description: Only recombined current-song adaptations can enter 01.

propagation_rule.description: 02/02A/02B consume the selected 01 director_chain, generation implications, and trace refs while 01R keeps the raw observation audit. 03 may use video_prompt_readiness_seed only after actual image pixels are available. 04 may use edit_readiness_seed only as candidate-narrowing intent before source-motion proof.

blocked_override_rule.description: 01R cannot override locked message, member identity, selected audio timing, wardrobe lane approvals, or founder review gates by itself.

selection_output.description: Optional record of the final selected 01R applications, whether chosen by founder or by delegated Codex selection.

rejected_or_held_references.description: Optional record of reference ideas intentionally rejected or held after selection.

source_identity_key.description: Stable identity for the original work/source. Multiple crops or segments from the same original keep the same key.

video_sequence_review.description: Required for video-derived units when duration_aware_selected_sequence.v1 is active.

selected_unit_ids.description: Subset of applied/combined units carried into selected applications. May contain fewer than three ids.

navigation_surface.description: First-pass source navigation only. Selected-event review may use explicit timestamps or a denser selected range.

selected_reference_attachment.description: Mandatory one-second-cadence evidence attached for the exact selected range in both duration lanes. It is an analysis/receipt surface, not a downstream frame quota.

selected_event_identity.description: The one contiguous action, relation, camera, object, world, or edit event represented by this unit.

screenCauseEffect.description: Current-song screen-flow application: visible cause -> visible effect -> viewer/camera change -> next-section bridge.

wardrobeRead.description: Current-song outfit application. Use this when a source observation changes what must be visibly worn, not only how fabric moves.
